test.query: SELECT sum(d IN (materialize(x))) FROM (SELECT toDecimal64(number % 100, 2) AS d, toFloat64(number % 100) AS x FROM numbers(10000000)) FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(ifNull(d = materialize(x), 0)) FROM (SELECT toDecimal64(number % 100, 2) AS d, toFloat64(number % 100) AS x FROM numbers(10000000)) FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(d IN (materialize(x))) FROM (SELECT toDecimal64(number % 100, 2) AS d, toInt64(number % 100) AS x FROM numbers(10000000)) FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(ifNull(d = materialize(x), 0)) FROM (SELECT toDecimal64(number % 100, 2) AS d, toInt64(number % 100) AS x FROM numbers(10000000)) FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(d IN (materialize(x))) FROM (SELECT toNullable(number) AS d, number AS x FROM numbers(10000000)) SETTINGS allow_lossy_numeric_supertype = 0, transform_null_in = 1 FORMAT Null
